_comment: Octail's own egg (LinuxGSM's boserver settings, its config.txt and its Ballistic Overkill library fix were read as a reference only). App 416880 (Ballistic Overkill Dedicated Server) from anonymous SteamCMD, the Linux build BODS.x86_64 started in batch mode. The game only reads config.txt in its folder (it has no option for another file, checked in its assemblies), which updates overwrite, so your settings live in octail-config.txt, a copy made once by the install (written from scratch when the game ships none) and copied over config.txt at every start; the file parser sets the name, game and query ports, slots, map, mode and password in it before every start, and the install adds any of those lines the file lacks. The game's 64-bit linux64/ (its steamclient.so: the 32-bit one next to the binary made Steam fail with "wrong ELF class"), the server's folder and BODS_Data/Plugins/x86_64 are put on LD_LIBRARY_PATH (LinuxGSM's fix), the Unity log goes to the console. Query port +1 (automatic variable, A2S: player count and the Players tab list). The server reads no console input; start detected by "HOST server ready" or the query port (UDP; the game binds no socket of its own on the game port, its traffic goes through Steam); stop with Ctrl+C. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times (its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration"), the steamcmd download times out and retries, and the install fails when the server binary is missing.
name: Ballistic Overkill
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Ballistic Overkill is a fast-paced, class-based team shooter by Aquiris: small maps, quick rounds and modes from team deathmatch to king of the hill, for up to 16 players.
startup: cp -f octail-config.txt config.txt || exit 1; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$(pwd)/linux64:$(pwd):$(pwd)/BODS_Data/Plugins/x86_64${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}"; exec ./BODS.x86_64 -batchmode -nographics -dedicated -logFile /dev/stdout

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Ballistic Overkill dedicated server (Octail's own install script; LinuxGSM's boserver settings were read as a
# reference only). App 416880, the Linux build, anonymous SteamCMD. Failures exit non-zero.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -uo pipefail

## anonymous login: the Ballistic Overkill server needs no Steam account
STEAM_USER=anonymous

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps # steamapps: SteamCMD's disk write error when it is missing
if ! curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o steamcmd.tar.gz \
    https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz; then
    echo "Installation failed: SteamCMD couldn't be downloaded."
    exit 1
fi
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise, even running as root; the files are given to the server's user after the install.
chown -R root:root /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install the server with steamcmd (the Linux depot)
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
BETA=()
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || BETA=(-beta "${SRCDS_BETAID}")
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID}" "${BETA[@]}" validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 and 64 bit Steam client libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/BODS.x86_64" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Ballistic Overkill dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi
chmod +x /mnt/server/BODS.x86_64

## Octail: your settings live in octail-config.txt, a copy of the game's config.txt that updates don't overwrite
## (written from scratch when the game ships none), copied over config.txt (the only file the game reads) at every start. Octail sets the lines below before every start; the line parser only
## replaces lines that are there, so missing ones are added.
cd /mnt/server || exit 1
if [[ ! -f octail-config.txt ]]; then
    if [[ -f config.txt ]]; then
        cp config.txt octail-config.txt
    else
        cat > octail-config.txt <<'OCTAIL_EOF'
# Ballistic Overkill server settings. Octail sets the name, ports, slots, map, mode and password from the Startup
# tab before every start; the other lines are yours (restart the server after editing).
ServerName=Ballistic Overkill server
ServerPort=27015
QueryPort=27016
MaxPlayers=12
MaxSpectators=4
MaxPing=0
GameMap=3
GameMode=4
MatchTime=10
Autobalance=1
Rounds=7
RoundTime=90
WarmUpTime=26
Password=
DedicatedBroadcast=1
BannerURL=
ClickURL=
OwnerId=
OCTAIL_EOF
    fi
fi
for key in ServerName ServerPort QueryPort MaxPlayers GameMap GameMode Password; do
    if ! grep -qE "^${key}=" octail-config.txt; then
        echo "${key}=" >> octail-config.txt
    fi
done

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server browser.

variables.name: Start Map
variables.description: The first map: 1 Sunnsquare Mall, 2 Corporate Park, 3 Hollow, 4 Nox Museum, 5 Overhead, 6 Citadel, 7 Hakim, 8 Blackfield, 9 Wonderdome, 10 Reinstate.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: 1 team deathmatch, 2 conquest, 3 king of the hill, 4 rounds, 5 free for all.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join. Empty = anyone can join.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port (UDP), written to octail-config.txt. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: The Steam app id of the Ballistic Overkill dedicated server.

variables.name: Beta Branch
variables.description: Optional: a Steam beta branch of the server; empty for the public build. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start (1), or start the installed files (0). Players can only join a server of their own game version.
